A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Before you
press play.

Curiosity looks good on you.

What is SaMaMoh?＋

SaMaMoh is an independent streaming-service concept with a curated catalogue, film discovery and a personal watchlist. The titles and memberships demonstrate the experience; playback features credited open films.

Can I try it without an account?＋

Absolutely. Browse the collection, play the open-film previews and save favourites straight away. Your watchlist stays in this browser.

Where can I watch?＋

Explore the site in a modern browser on your phone, tablet, laptop or desktop. A stable internet connection is needed for video playback.

Will I be charged?＋

No. This is a portfolio demonstration. The prices are illustrative, no payment details are collected, and choosing a plan creates no subscription.

How do profiles and my list work?＋

You can create a local demo profile with your name. The profile, favourites and playback progress are saved only on this device. They do not sync across browsers.
